title: Four years of secret funding before History Channel

tellings.quote: who I was funding this investigation and keep keeping it completely secret and confidential for 4 years before being persuaded by the History Channel

plain: The owner of Skinwalker Ranch, a property in Utah known for reports of strange events, says that from about 2016 he paid for a scientific investigation of the ranch and kept it completely secret and confidential for four years. He tells it as his own decision, saying he went public only after the History Channel, a US television network, persuaded him to. It would mean the work there began as a private, serious inquiry rather than as a television show.
